traceability.notes: All functional acceptance criteria for 010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT are implemented and verified. The plugin supports the @implements annotation format, validates referenced requirements per story file (including multi-story and shared-ID scenarios), preserves existing @story/@req behavior, supports mixed usage, and provides clear, story-aware error messages. Comprehensive Jest tests cover both format-level and deep validation flows for @implements, and the test suite passes. Documentation (story + ADR) aligns with the implemented behavior. Therefore this story is fully satisfied.
